text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and latency spike observed in AWS ap-south-1 affecting Hosted API frontend and multiple Dedicated pools. Auto-escalating to SEV-2. Alerts: 503-rate > 4x baseline, p95 latency > 1200ms. Links: https://grafana.internal/alerts/1912345678, https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1912345678

oncall-jen: I'm on it. Paging @sam-infra @maria-sre. First pass: is this purely network/region or downstream auth/observability?

sam-infra: seeing a ton of 503s from AWS API Gateway and some IAM STS throttles in CloudTrail. Patchy across multiple AZs in ap-south-1.

maria-sre: Confirmed. Hosted API frontends show 503s returned ~service-proxy->apigateway: "503 Service Unavailable". Dedicated pools that call regional control plane see increased request timeouts.

oncall-jen: Quick mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback to eu-west-1 for new requests 2) scale up dedicated pool eviction buffers to reduce backlog 3) enable request-level retries with exponential backoff for internal control plane calls 4) open AWS support case and post to AWS health.

ops-bot: Executing playbook step: enable-fallback-routing -> triggered. Route weight set: ap-south-1 0.3, eu-west-1 0.7. (cmd: ./admin route set --region-fallback ap-south-1=0.3,eu-west-1=0.7)

alex-eng: Heads-up: fallback will increase cross-region egress and token TTL considerations. I pushed a temporary tweak to token validation TTL to avoid reauth storms.

kevin-support: Kustomer-facing note drafted: "We are investigating elevated errors in ap-south-1; traffic is being routed to other regions to reduce errors. Some customers may see slightly higher latencies while we mitigate." Shall I post to status page?

liz-product: Yes please post now. Add suggested ETA for update in 30m and ask customers to contact support if they see persistent 5xx.

oncall-jen: Posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1912345678/posted. Also opening AWS case (case # 1234567890) and included CloudWatch traces and request IDs.

sam-infra: Quick debug logs:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:41Z] proxy-frontend-12: upstream=apigw.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com, status=503, err="503 Service Unavailable"
[2026-03-15T18:02:41Z] controlplane-client: STS:GetCallerIdentity -> ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded
[2026-03-15T18:02:43Z] pool-dedicated-04: queue-latency=980ms, token-validate=430ms, downstream-5xx=12/min
```

maria-sre: Observability vendor (thirdparty-obs) also reporting ingestion delays in ap-south-1 region which is making error triage harder; pulling logs from local node storage now. Also seeing elevated retry storms from clients that don't honor backoff.

oncall-jen: Adding short term guard: enforce client-side retry budget at gateway (max 2 retries, jittered). Patch deployed to frontends.

ops-bot: Playbook: enforce-retry-budget -> applied (gw-config v3.1.2).

kevin-support: Customer impact list from billing/entitlements: 14 mid-market customers in ap-south-1 Dedicated pools, ~1200 hosted API keys with notable error spikes. I can DM a list to SEs.

alex-eng: For Dedicated pools: temporarily increase standby capacity and keep canary capacity in eu-west-1 to absorb redirects. Scaling command: ./infra scale-pool --pool-id dp-aps-01 --replicas +3 (applied).

oncall-jen: Good. Also disable some non-critical background jobs that hit control plane to reduce pressure (jobs: async-embeddings-refresh, model-metrics-sync).

maria-sre: AWS status updated: "We are investigating elevated API errors in ap-south-1 affecting API Gateway and IAM endpoints." They've acknowledged a regional control plane disruption.

kevin-support: Posted update to customers + alerted enterprise accounts. A few have already opened support cases; routing to SEs.

sam-infra: Continuing to see 503 rates trending down after fallback and retry budget changes, p95 at ~450ms now (was >1200ms). Still some 5xx from Dedicated pools that bind to ap-south-1 resources.

oncall-jen: Next steps: 1) continue fallback weighting until AWS confirms recovery 2) track customer tickets + correlate with pool mappings 3) post postmortem skeleton in #postmortems 4) handoff to night oncall in 45m unless escalated.

liz-product: Can we capture an impact matrix: number of affected customers, % of traffic for hosted, list of Dedicated pool IDs? I can help compile so comms are accurate.

kevin-support: I'll extract that and DM a spreadsheet link.

alex-eng: Note — token TTL tweak reverted for stability after initial burst. Reverted at 18:22Z.

maria-sre: Partial recovery reported by AWS at 18:30Z; API errors dropping but still present. Keeping fallback until stable for 30m.

oncall-jen: Creating incident channel and timeline notes. Posting RCA tasks: (1) investigate cascade cause (api-gateway <-> iam throttling interplay), (2) improve regional fallback automation, (3) better observability for third-party ingestion delays, (4) add crowded-retry-signal to evade retry storms.

ops-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1912345678. Ticket with AWS updated: case #1234567890 now in "investigating" with Sr. Eng on call.

alex-eng: Handoff to night oncall @alex-eng in 45m. If any regression, page paging_policy:sev1.

oncall-jen: Handing off now — summary: ap-south-1 regional API Gateway/IAM control plane degradation led to elevated 503s and p95 latency. We routed traffic to eu-west-1, enforced retry budgets, scaled Dedicated pools in fallback region. Customers notified. AWS engaged. Monitoring for full recovery. Leaving runbook + logs in #incident-1912345678.

alex-eng: Ack, taking over monitoring. I'll update status in 30m or on any bump.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: SEV-2 -> monitoring. Metrics snapshot: 5xx-rate down to 1.1x baseline, p95 latency 380ms. Logged: incident-1912345678/monitoring.

kevin-support: Posting final immediate-customer update: "We routed traffic to alternate regions to reduce errors. AWS is investigating; we will update as we have more info. If you continue to see errors please reply to your support case."

maria-sre: Leaving final note: preserve logs for 30 days for RCA. Setting follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC to run through timeline and long-term mitigations.

oncall-jen: Closing realtime thread; move discussion to #incident-1912345678 for RCA artifacts. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
